snp5.16:1.1:
Twice now, Sakyan,
I’ve asked you,
snp5.16:1.3:
but you, One with Eyes,
haven’t answered me.
snp5.16:1.4:
“When asked the third time,
the divine seer answers”:
snp5.16:2.2: the Brahmā world with its devas:
snp5.16:2.3: I don’t know how they’re viewed
snp5.16:3.1:
So to the one who has seen
to the far extreme,
snp5.16:3.2: I’ve come with a desire for a question:
snp5.16:3.3: One who regards the world in what way
snp5.16:4.3:
having removed any view
in terms of self.
snp5.16:4.4:
This way
one is above & beyond death.
snp5.16:4.5:
One who regards the world
in this way
